contextThreshold.label: Context Threshold
contextThreshold.help: Fraction of context window that triggers compaction (0.0–1.0)

collapseThreshold.label: Collapse Threshold
collapseThreshold.help: Emergency collapse threshold (0.0–1.0). Above this, compaction uses aggressive mode.

incrementalMaxDepth.label: Incremental Max Depth
incrementalMaxDepth.help: How deep incremental compaction goes (0 = leaf only, -1 = unlimited)

freshTailCount.label: Fresh Tail Count
freshTailCount.help: Number of recent messages protected from compaction

leafMinFanout.label: Leaf Min Fanout
leafMinFanout.help: Minimum depth-0 summaries needed before condensation (default: 8)

condensedMinFanout.label: Condensed Min Fanout
condensedMinFanout.help: Minimum depth>=1 summaries needed for condensation (default: 4)

leafTargetTokens.label: Leaf Target Tokens
leafTargetTokens.help: Target token count for leaf (first-level) summaries

condensedTargetTokens.label: Condensed Target Tokens
condensedTargetTokens.help: Target token count for condensed (merged) summaries

summaryModel.label: Summary Model
summaryModel.help: Model override for LCM summarization (e.g., 'gpt-5.4' or 'openai-resp/gpt-5.4')
